resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 5,458 ft (1,664 m). The FFLOS description, the 2024 Stanislaus post and Peakbagging give 5,449 to 5,452 ft. The record keeps the register figure; the gap is a few feet.

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1934 build, the 1989 burn and the concrete slab. The 2023 Stanislaus post refers to 1938 and the 2024 post dates its photo to August 1953; neither changes the story. No staffing, fire or access source for this site was found, so those keys are omitted. The Weebly Crandall page holds only a title and a removal field, so it is not cited. No photo URL was captured, so no photos are added.
